title: Harry Potter Victor Krum Jada Nano Metal Figure Die-Cast Metalfigs 2" #7
descriptionText: The product is a 2" die-cast metal figure of Victor Krum from the Harry Potter franchise, produced by JADA. The figure is a collectible item inspired by the fantasy genre and is made in China. This intricately detailed nano metal figure captures the essence of the character from the popular Harry Potter series, making it a must-have for avid collectors and fans of the magical world created by J.K. Rowling.
